messages:
Marta - Procurement: Heads up 4e2d MatrixEmbed renewal hit inbox. They introduced a dedicated-on-prem option vs cloud metered. Need quick triage: cost, ops, and security tradeoffs. Proposal in Drive: https://drive.google.com/matrixembed. @Diego @Noor @Hana @Priya

Diego (Finance): Paste pricing lines here if possible. We should run 12-month TCO for both paths.

Marta - Procurement: Quote snippet:
```
Cloud Metered:
  $0.000018/embed
  Quarterly volume tiers (>1B/qtr -> 14% off)
  Monthly billing, NET30
Dedicated On-Prem:
  One-time setup: $45k
  Annual infra fee: $36k (includes 600M embeds/month)
  Overage: $0.000010/embed
  Support: 24x7 enterprise (SLA incl.)
Notes: 12-mo term; data residency selectable
```

Noor (ML Eng): Our current run ~130M/mo. Cloud metered looks cheaper now. Dedicated makes sense if we grow >600M or need isolated env + lower p95. Ask for hybrid: smaller on-prem reserve + cloud overflow. Also clarify whether "embed" meter counts per-vector or charges by vector-dimension compute.

Hana (Security): For dedicated on-prem, what access do they need? Do they ship a VM image or SaaS gateway? Also require SOC2 + encryption at rest and in-transit. Need export/wipe terms on termination.

Priya (Legal): Contract asks: include incident credits, explicit meter definition, audit rights, and change-of-control protection. For dedicated plan, require clear acceptance test and performance SLAs.

MatrixEmbed Rep: Hi all ":wave:" We can offer hybrid: 50% on-prem reserved capacity (300M/mo) + cloud overflow @ $0.000011/embed. Dedicated is delivered as a tenant VM + onboarding support; we require outbound telemetry for billing only. SOC2 report available. We can provide sample invoice and metering spec.

Diego (Finance): Good. Please send sample peak-month invoice and a modeled annual cost for (a) current run, (b) 2x growth, (c) with hybrid. Also confirm payment terms for one-time setup.

Noor (ML Eng): Also request p50/p95 latency for embedding endpoints on dedicated vs cloud under our QPS. If dedicated p95 > cloud by much, discount request.

MatrixEmbed Rep: Will provide revised quote + sample invoices + latency matrix + metering spec by EOD tomorrow. Also open to a one-time onboarding credit.

Marta - Procurement: Thanks. @Procurement-Bot open PR when docs arrive. Approvers: Diego (Finance), Priya (Legal), Hana (Security).

Procurement-Bot: Created PR #562: "MatrixEmbed renewal - dedicated vs cloud review". Approvers requested: Diego (Finance), Priya (Legal), Hana (Security). Link: https://procurement.internal/pr/562

Marta - Procurement: Ill schedule a 20-min triage once we have the revised materials. :thumbsup:
